g.text: Ablation curve on VPD's 67M Pile target — best of 5 seeds

text.style: font-size: 14.21px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: The 4-layer 67M model from the VPD paper (wandb goodfire/spd/t-9d2b8f02): 24 decomposable matrices, 28.3M parameters, C=256, an 8,192-position

text.style: font-size: 14.21px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: pilot, the production GIM sensor. Seed 0, chosen as the widest separation between the best arm and the current method across five seeds.

text.style: font-size: 14.21px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: On this model the win comes from dropping the spherical normalisation (48 vs 24 components removable within 0.05 nats), NOT from transposing —

text.style: font-size: 14.21px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: which is the opposite of what the same study found on Llama-3.2-1B. One run of all four arms takes 30 seconds.
